note: Bland County's zoning ordinance adopts an Official Zoning Map, but no public queryable zoning district service was found. The county's GIS portal (blandcova.interactivegis.com) is behind a login page and exposes no ArcGIS REST services (probes of /arcgis/rest/services and /server/rest/services returned 404). Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no official Bland County zoning layer; the only Bland parcel service found requires a token. No Town of Bland zoning layer was found either.
